<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,BoldItalic,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#ed7d31">DMD Gene Phenotype Description:</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Most common form of muscular dystrophy; a sex-linked recessive disorder. It typically presents in boys aged 3 to 7 year as</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">proximal muscle weakness causing waddling gait, toe-walking, lordosis, frequent falls, and difficulty in standing up and</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">climbing up stairs. The pelvic girdle is affected first, then the shoulder girdle. Progression is steady and most patients are</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">confined to a wheelchair by age of 10 or 12. Flexion contractures and scoliosis ultimately occur. About 50% of patients</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">have a lower IQ than their genetic expectations would suggest. There is no treatment.</span> 
</p>

<span style="font-family:Calibri,Bold,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Indication :</span>

<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#ffffff;background-color:#1f497d;padding:2px 6px;display:inline-block">Case Specific Recommendations:</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">1.</span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Segregation analysis of the variant by Sanger /Exome sequencing/ MLPA is recommended.</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#ffffff;background-color:#1f497d;padding:2px 6px;display:inline-block">Recommendations</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Genetic counseling is advised for interpretation on the consequences of the variant(s).</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">We recommend confirming the presence of these variants by Sanger Sequencing/ MLPA.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Segregation analysis of the variant by Sanger /Exome sequencing/ MLPA is recommended.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">The significance/classification of the variants might change based on parental and family members genetic testing.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,Bold,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">For questions about this report, or for assistance in locating nearby genetic counseling services, please contact</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,Bold,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">the Laboratory: contact@sngenelab.com.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">If results obtained do not match the clinical findings, additional testing should be considered as per referring</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">clinician's recommendation.</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#ffffff;background-color:#1f497d;padding:2px 6px;display:inline-block">Methodology:</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Next Generation Sequencing: DNA extracted from Blood, Saliva, Amniotic fluid, CVS or any other standard source is</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">used for targeted capture-based Library preparation. Targeted capture provides an efficient and sensitive means for</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">sequencing specific genomic regions in a high-throughput manner. The libraries were sequenced to mean >85-100x</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">coverage on Illumina Novaseq X sequencing platform with Paired End 2x150 chemistry.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">We follow the Illumina DRAGEN Bio-IT Platform for identification of variants in the sample. The sequences obtained</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">are assembled and aligned to reference sequences based on NCBI RefSeq transcripts and human genome build</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">(GRCh38).</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">This assay (Whole exome sequencing) covers 20321 genes including 37 mitochondria genes.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Haplotype caller has been used to identify variants which are relevant to the clinical indication.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">In addition to SNVs and small Indels, copy number variants (CNVs) are detected from targeted sequence data using the</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">commercially available algorithm. This algorithm detects rare CNVs based on comparison of the read-depths of the test</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">data with the matched aggregate reference dataset.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Clinically relevant mutations were annotated using published variants in literature, Commercial datasets and a set of</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">diseases databases. Common variants are filtered based on allele frequency in 1000Genome, ExAC, gnomAD, dbSNP &</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">SN Genelab's internal database.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Non-synonymous variants effect is calculated using multiple algorithms such as PolyPhen-2, SIFT, MutationTaster2.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Based on annotations data, ACMG rules-based classification performed for classification of variants identified through</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">next generation sequencing study.</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#ffffff;background-color:#1f497d;padding:2px 6px;display:inline-block">Limitations/Disclaimer:</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">It should be noted that this test does not sequence all bases in a human genome, not all variants have been identified</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">or interpreted, and this report is limited only to variants with evidence for causing or contributing to disease/clinical</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">details provided to SN Gene Lab Pvt Ltd.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Testing has been performed assuming that the sample received belongs to the above named individual and any stated</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">relationships between individuals are accepted as true.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Test results are interpreted in the context of clinical findings, family history and other laboratory data. Only variations</span>

<p>
<span style="font-family:Calibri,Bold,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Ref. By</span> 
<span style="font-family:Calibri,Bold,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">:</span> 
<span style="font-family:Calibri,Bold,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Report Version</span> 
<span style="font-family:Calibri,Bold,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">: 1</span>

<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Calibri,Bold,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Indication :</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">in genes potentially related to the proband's medical condition are reported. Rare polymorphisms may lead to false</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">negative or positive results. Misinterpretation of results may occur if the information provided is inaccurate or</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">incomplete. The results should be interpreted in the context of the patient’s medical evaluation, family history and</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">racial/ethnic background. Please note that variant classification and/or interpretation may change over time if more</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">information available. Re-interpretation of multi gene next generation sequencing data is recommended on an annual</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">basis and may be requested by a medical provider.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">The sensitivity of this assay to detect large deletions/duplications of more than 10 bp or copy number variations</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">(CNV) is 70-75%. The CNVs detected with this assay have to be confirmed by alternate method such as MLPA &</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Microarray.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Due to inherent technology limitations, coverage is not uniform across all regions. Hence pathogenic variants present</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">in areas of insufficient coverage as well as those variants which currently do not co-relate with the provided</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">phenotype may not be analyzed/ reported. Additionally, it may not be possible to fully resolve certain details about</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">variants, such as mosaicism, phasing, or mapping ambiguity.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Triplet repeat expansions, translocations, large deletion or duplications and chromosomal rearrangements events are</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">currently not reliably detected by next generation sequencing.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">This assay is not meant to interrogate most promoter regions, deep intronic regions, or other regulatory elements,</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">other gene rearrangements like inversion or translocation and does not detect single or multi-exon deletions or</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">duplications.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Incidental or secondary findings (if any) that meet the ACMG guidelines can be given upon request.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Genes with pseudogenes, paralog genes and genes with low complexity may have decreased sensitivity and specificity</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">of variant detection and interpretation due to inability of the data and analysis tools to unambiguously determine the</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">origin of the sequence data in such regions.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Sequence and copy number variants are reported according to the Human Genome Variation Society (HGVS).</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Symbol,sans-serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000"></span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">The transcript used for clinical reporting generally represents the canonical transcript, which is usually the longest</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">coding transcript with strong/multiple supporting evidence. However, clinically relevant variants annotated in</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">alternate complete coding transcripts could also be reported.</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#ffffff;background-color:#1f497d;padding:2px 6px;display:inline-block">*Variant classification as per ACMG guidelines:</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Variant</span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">A change in a gene. This could be disease causing (pathogenic) or not disease causing (benign).</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Benign</span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">A variant which is known not to be responsible for disease has been detected. Generally, no</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">further action is warranted on such variants when detected.</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Likely Benign</span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">A variant which is very unlikely to contribute to the development of disease however, the</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">scientific evidence is currently insufficient to prove this conclusively. Additional evidence is</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">expected to confirm this assertion of Pathogenicity.</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Pathogenic</span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">A disease-causing variation in a gene which can explain the patient's symptoms has been detected.</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">This usually means that a suspected disorder for which testing had been requested has been</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">confirmed.</span> 
</p>

<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">A variant has been detected, but it is difficult to classify it as either pathogenic (disease causing) or</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Uncertain</span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">benign (non-disease causing) based on current available scientific evidence. Further testing of the</span> 
</p>
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">Significance</span> 
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">patient or family members as recommended by your clinician may be needed. It is probable that</span> 
</p>
<br />
<p>
<span style="font-family:Cambria,serif;font-size:10.0pt;color:#000000">their significance can be assessed only with time, subject to availability of scientific evidence.</span> 
</p>
